verdict.rationale: A 3D engine with first-party tools such as the Playground, Inspector and Node Material Editor could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Babylon.js generating AI insights or suggestions inside the product. Its llms.txt files only expose documentation for external LLMs, which is an adjacent feature and not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
